notes: Form D (filed 2026-03-17, first sale 2026-03-06, Delaware, incorporated 2023, Chattanooga TN): USD 10.75M sold of 11.85M offered, 4 investors, related persons George Webster (CEO, director), Marton Sarkadi Nagy (director; Partner at Visionaries per the firm's team page), Benjamin Holzman (director), Aurelia von Pentz (director). The Visionaries partner's board seat ties the firm to this round (firm_in_round inferred true), but the filing does not name the fund or the round, and Visionaries could have held the converted SAFE before; entry left undetermined with the 2026-03 round as the earliest dated tie. Visionaries listed Ziggiz only on the 2026 site. Non-dilutive: DARPA origin funding, ARPA-H SBIR Phase I (2024-09) and Phase IIb USD 3.5M (2026-08-17); Databricks AI accelerator investment (2025-12). No non-vendor source names the 2024 seed.
